items.name: base
items.title: Earth base
items.description: Earth (setmore-black) tokens, shadcn aliases, focus ring and the Inter font. Install first.

items.name: font-inter
items.title: Inter
items.description: Earth's typeface.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of headings that each show or hide a section of content.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that asks people to confirm an important or destructive action.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A tinted message inside the page that draws attention to information or a problem.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps content, such as an image or video, at a fixed width-to-height ratio.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's photo, with their initials as a fallback.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label for a status, count or category.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where the current page sits in the app and links back to its parents.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins related buttons, inputs and labels into one control.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Use one default button per view for the main action.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Lets people pick a date or a range of dates from a month grid.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered surface that groups related content and actions.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Scrolls through a row of slides with buttons, swipe or the arrow keys.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts charts with Earth's chart palette, tooltip and legend.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Lets people turn an option on or off, or pick several options from a list.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A section that can be expanded and collapsed with a trigger.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text input that filters a list of options as people type.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of commands or options, inline or as a ⌘K palette.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of actions that opens on right-click or long press.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over the page for a focused task, such as editing a record.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and can be swiped away, built for touch screens.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A list of actions or options that opens from a button.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A placeholder for a view with no content yet, with a next step.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Lays out a form control with its label, description and error message.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Previews the content behind a link when people hover or focus it.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Adds icons, text or buttons inside an input or textarea.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Collects a one-time passcode one character at a time.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field. Pair it with a Label, or a Field for descriptions and errors.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row with media, a title, a description and actions, for lists of things like staff or services.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a form control. Clicking the label focuses or toggles its control.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A horizontal bar of menus, like the File and Edit menus of a desktop app.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A styled native select element. Use it when the browser's own picker is preferred, such as on mobile.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A row of top-level links whose triggers open panels of related links.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves between pages of a long list, such as customers or past appointments.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Shows extra content or a small form in a floating panel next to its trigger.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how far a task such as an import or upload has got.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Lets people pick exactly one option from a short list.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels that people can resize by dragging the handle between them.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable region with a slim, consistent scrollbar.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Lets people choose one option from a menu of options.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin line that separates content, horizontally or vertically.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, for side tasks and details.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible app sidebar with groups, menus, badges and a mobile sheet.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder shown while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a value, or a range of values, by dragging along a track.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Shows brief notifications, such as a booking confirmation, at the edge of the screen.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An animated indicator that shows something is loading.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a single setting on or off, taking effect immediately.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns of data, such as bookings or payments.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between related views that share one place on the page.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field for notes, messages and descriptions.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Shows brief notifications with Base UI's toast manager, styled as an EDS snackbar.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggles where one, or several, can be pressed at a time.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed or unpressed, such as a filter chip.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears when people hover or focus a control.
